thread:
Sam: Heads-up  we need to standardize how CS captures product asks from onboarding + support. Goal: 7
10 clean cards each week that are triage-ready.

Jen: Agree. Suggest a tiny template so PM can triage without follow-up. Paste template into the shared sheet and well run a weekly scrub.

Omar (PM): Template looks good. Important: mark any item that mentions renewal or contract concerns with [RENEWAL-RISK] and add "approx revenue at risk" if known. P0 = blocks renewal or production.

Leo: Quick checklist for cards: repro steps or sample input, expected vs actual, screenshots or CSV, reporter contact. If missing, mark as partial and tag CS follow-up.

Sam: Proposed mini-template:

```
Customer: [name]
Pain (1 line):
Ask (1 line):
Impact (1 line): ops / renewal / revenue / time saved
Priority: P0/P1/P2
Reporter + source + date:
Attachments: recording / ticket / csv
Action owner: CS / PM / Eng
```

Jen: Adding first two cards from yesterday's onboarding:
Jen: Card1 -> Customer: Lumen Logistics | Pain: embeddings drift for SKU matching after nightly ETL (~5% mismatch) | Ask: retrain/update embed pipeline or expose fresher embeddings API | Impact: alerts + manual fixes, potential renewal discussion in Q3 | Priority: P1 [RENEWAL-RISK] | Reporter: onboarding call 5/4 | Attachments: CSV sample, logs | Action owner: Eng - NLP

Jen: Card2 -> Customer: BeaconPay | Pain: billing granularity lacks team filter, finance can't allocate charges | Ask: per-route billing export + CSV report | Impact: finance work-arounds, renewal flagged in account health | Priority: P0 [RENEWAL-RISK] | Reporter: support ticket 8721 | Attachments: billing sample rows | Action owner: PM + Eng

Omar (PM): Good. @Leo, can you triage the Lumen one for complexity? If it's quick (config or small pipeline tweak), we can include in next sprint.

Leo: I'll triage. If it needs retrain, we'll estimate. Also note: for billing asks, include an example of expected CSV schema to avoid back-and-forth.

CS Bot: Reminder: cards saved to sheet https://sheet.link/weekly-cards. Use card id when you reference tickets. Draft autosaves are available.

Sam: Weekly cadence: Wed EOD add cards, Thurs triage review, Fri PMs assign top 3 to sprint or backlog. If renewal-risk items exist, escalate into Monday exec recap.

Jen: I'll create a short script for CS to use on calls so asks are more concrete. Will drop it in the sheet by EOD today.

Omar (PM): If anyone's unsure on priority, default P2 and tag me. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
